content: The median Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for Tirzepatide, a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), is $1,228 per 30-day supply. The median National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) for the same medication is $982 for a 30-day supply. This pricing corresponds to the administration of a 15 mg dose of Tirzepatide.
